name: flow-field
title: Flow Field
description: Wind drawn as streamlines on a canvas. The cursor is a disc the air flows around. Rests off screen and stills under reduced motion.

props.name: density
props.description: Multiplies the number of streamlines (about 420 at 1).

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the wind blows. 0 holds a still frame.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The cursor parts the streams like a disc in the air. Off on touch screens and under reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
